Name: Seasonal Digspots
Author: onlyonechris
Description:
Replaces the sprites for the standard artifact dig spots with [color=#ffff00]over 100 different sprites[/color], broken down into seasonal variants. (Will not change the number of dig spot spawns.
You will want a mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3340?tab=files&file_id=20326]Increased Artifact Spots[/url] for increasing the amount of digspots.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8270/8270-1616682182-62147586.png[/img]

I get bored seeing the same thing so I went of a tear one night and made a ton of different sprites for my digspots. I don't think I will post pictures of all because some of recolors and it's a lot of images to post here. Plus, it's nice to have some mystery :p

Some are glints, like when you see light striking something in the corner of you eye.
Some are sparkles which are exactly as they sound.
Some are fairies pointing you to the treasure
Some are baby plants to adorable to ignore
Some are creatures hiding under mushrooms (or are they the mushrooms??)
Some are spooky
Some are weird
I hope you like them all!

I haven't tested all the sprites in game yet and I expect to fine tune them as well as add more as time allows. 

My other mod - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8199?tab=description]Curvy Girl[/url]
